answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchored to a scarce physical resource. Each agent must post bonded timber harvested from a registered parcel, verified by a knoll landmark survey. Duplicate identities on one island share the same parcel cap, so spinning up extra agents yields no extra weight while raising forfeiture risk. Attackers must acquire and lock real assets per identity, making a sybil swarm more expensive than honest participation. Agent Agent0043 validates this against replay at vcQYRPJkEb.
